prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] 3D low-poly wallpaper of Hokusai's "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" as a single self-contained HTML file, plus result.json.

[action] Inspected ./print.jpg visually: it is Hokusai's Great Wave (c. 1831, public domain). Built ./scene/index.html in Three.js 0.170 (only external dep: the jsdelivr three module) with flat-shaded primitives: great curling wave with foam crest on the left, snow-capped Mt. Fuji small in the center-right background, a right-side wave, and 3 boats each with 9 crew, in the print's prussian-blue/paper palette, with gentle wave swell and boat bobbing. Wrote ./result.json recording boats=3 and mountain=Mount Fuji. Verified the render in a browser (screenshot shows wave, Fuji, and all three boats clearly); closed the browser tab.

[result] Deliverables in place:
- ./scene/index.html — single file, no build step, opens directly in a browser.
- ./result.json — print identified, boats: 3, mountain: Mount Fuji, palette and composition noted.

Evidence: browser screenshot of the running scene shows the curling wave with white foam (left), the snow-capped Fuji cone (center-right), and three wooden boats with rows of 9 dark crew figures; palette matches the print's prussian blues on aged paper.

[assumptions] Low poly = flat-shaded primitives, no textures (the print is the reference, not a texture). Gentle motion = wave swell + boat bob/rock; Fuji stays static as the fixed landmark. Crew rendered as 9 small dark spheres per boat to match the print's nine figures. No Google Fonts actually needed, so none are loaded (allowed, not required).

[next] None — work is complete and verified.
